verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents an official MCP server, both self-run and hosted, so users can manage flags with natural-language commands through an external AI client. That makes natural-language operation possible but indirect: it depends on a separate agent tool, and the pack shows no native natural-language command interface in the product itself. missing for 10: a built-in natural-language assistant in the LaunchDarkly UI, documented detail on which operations work via natural language (the entries are titles only), and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
